title: The Breath Is a Letter
label: ch:bn-breath-is-a-letter
canDo: I can write five Bengali consonants as cells of one grid — lips and throat, each with the voice and the breath switched on or off — read আবার and ভালো with them, and close the throat row with গ so that লাগলো becomes readable.

payoff.summary: The throat row is closed — ক, খ, গ in one place with two switches — and লাগলো, waiting since the introductions chapter, becomes readable in the same breath.
